sourceDescription:
Situé à seulement quelques pas du Jardin des Plantes, cet appartement de 119 m² bénéficie d'un emplacement privilégié à proximité immédiate de toutes les commodités. Commerces, écoles, transports et services sont accessibles en quelques minutes, offrant un cadre de vie particulièrement agréable au quotidien.

Traversant et baigné de lumière, cet appartement séduit dès l'entrée par ses beaux volumes et son atmosphère chaleureuse. Une vaste entrée avec placards dessert une grande pièce de vie lumineuse bénéficiant d'une double exposition et d'un accès à deux balcons/loggias. La cuisine, aménagée et équipée, complète cet espace de vie convivial.

L'espace nuit se compose de quatre chambres confortables, dont une avec sa propre loggia, d'une salle d'eau et de WC indépendants.

Vous apprécierez particulièrement sa luminosité exceptionnelle, ses volumes généreux, son parquet ainsi que ses trois balcons/loggias qui prolongent agréablement les espaces de vie.

Pour un confort optimal, ce bien est vendu avec un garage privatif, une cave et un grenier, des annexes particulièrement recherchées dans ce secteur.

Un bien familial rare, offrant une adresse de premier choix à proximité immédiate du Jardin des Plantes et de l'ensemble des commodités.

Contactez-nous dès maintenant pour organiser une visite.

Les informations sur les risques auxquels ce bien est exposé sont disponibles sur le site Géorisques : www.georisques.gouv.fr

notes: Pending rather than trusted because fresh current Citya evidence and primary April 2026 notarial evidence identify the same physical Angers Jardin des Plantes apartment but expose unresolved material factual differences. The Citya page was freshly fetched and read in full on 2026-10-08. It explicitly labels publication on 01 October 2026 and exposes the complete EUR 330,000 asking price with seller-paid fees, 119 m², six rooms, four bedrooms, fourth floor in an eight-level building, lift, construction year 1964, 39.19 m² séjour, one shower room, collective gas radiator heating, three balconies/loggias, garage, cave, grenier, 649 copropriété lots, EUR 2,820 annual current charges, EUR 2,585 annual property tax, DPE D at 152 kWhEP/m²/year, GES D at 33 kg CO2/m²/year and EUR 1,460 to EUR 2,030 annual energy-cost estimate. All ten original Citya gallery files, including lazy and embedded carousel URLs, were downloaded and individually visually inspected at original-source resolution. Images 1 through 3 are coherent complementary views of the same empty large double-exposure living/dining room with parquet and glazed loggia access; image 4 shows the fitted independent kitchen; image 5 shows the entrance/hall and storage doors; images 6 through 9 show four distinct empty bedrooms with mutually coherent windows, outlooks, parquet and radiators, with image 6 showing floor-to-ceiling glazed loggia access; image 10 shows the actual shower room. No image is labelled virtual staging or AI-generated, and no obvious synthetic edit, stock mismatch, house, boat, commercial premises, tenancy document, person or impossible layout was found. The gallery does not show the WC, garage, cave, grenier, building exterior or all balcony surfaces, so those remain text-supported only. Empty rooms do not establish legal vacancy and no vacancy claim is made. The full current Citya wording contains no current tenant, lease, occupied sale, delayed vacancy, viager, bare ownership, fractional ownership, timeshare, auction, starting price, commercial or managed lease, houseboat or ancillary-only sale. Exact source-ID and first-photo-URL scans across all current reviewed and pending evidence found no prior record. An active-export near-unit scan for Angers apartments of 95–135 m² priced EUR 250,000–410,000 found no existing candidate, and the current reviewed-text match was an unrelated 71 m² Laforêt unit. Physical-unit research nonetheless found official April 2026 Notaires des Pays de Loire evidence for ref 49009-1356: the same Jardin des Plantes 119 m², 39 m² parquet living room with loggias, four bedrooms including one with loggia, cave, grenier and garage. That primary evidence describes five rooms, a double garage, EUR 373 monthly charges including heating and hot/cold water, 149 principal copro lots, energy 171/37 and annual energy cost EUR 1,620–2,250. Historical Immonot evidence for the same notarial ref reports 119.78 m², five rooms and EUR 345,840 including a EUR 15,840 buyer-paid fee over EUR 330,000 net. The present Citya mandate instead reports six rooms, a private garage, EUR 2,820 annual charges, energy 152/33 and seller-paid fees. The 649 total lots versus 149 principal lots may reflect different lot scopes, and the price/fee and energy differences may reflect a later mandate, price change or newer diagnostic, but the current sources do not reconcile them. The room count, charge basis and garage description are material enough to require source-document confirmation before approval.
